actions.exact_result_status: IEDC reported Meta broke ground on a more-than-$10 billion LEAP campus and described state performance-based data-center sales-tax incentives. This is a state/company milestone, not a reconstructed local vote.

actions.body: City of Lebanon / State of Indiana / Boone County Economic Development Corporation
actions.exact_result_status: City release states Meta officially broke ground on a new data center campus in Lebanon and describes the public-private project at LEAP.
actions.access_caveat: Official city news release; not a building-permit record.

actions.exact_result_status: Meta announced the Lebanon campus as a state-of-the-art 1GW data center, with more than $10 billion investment, more than 4,000 peak construction jobs, and about 300 operational jobs.
actions.access_caveat: Company source; used for owner scope and capacity rather than local land-use approval.

actions.exact_result_status: Mortenson reported it began supporting construction of Meta's Lebanon data center campus and described the campus as approximately 4 million square feet.
actions.access_caveat: Contractor source; corroborates construction activity but is not a permit record.

actions.exact_result_status: APC recommended a one-year moratorium on new unincorporated data centers, 6–0.
actions.access_caveat: The county release is a retrospective official account of the APC vote; it does not identify a Meta project case number.

actions.exact_result_status: APC reaffirmed the moratorium recommendation after a public hearing, 6–0.
actions.access_caveat: Official county release; the moratorium applies to new unincorporated facilities and is not proof of cancellation of Meta's LEAP project.

actions.exact_result_status: Commissioners unanimously approved a one-year moratorium on filing, processing, review, and acceptance of applications for new data centers in unincorporated Boone County, effective 2026-06-16 through 2027-06-15.
actions.case_or_permit_number: Moratorium ordinance number not stated in release
actions.access_caveat: Official release gives the result but not the ordinance number or individual roll call.
